# Rory Lancman (D): NYS Senate, District 7

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Rory Lancman's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://roryforstatesenate.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Jake Blumencranz](../blumencranz-jake/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/lancman-rory> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

Most of his résumé checks out: Assembly, City Council, state ratepayer counsel, NIFA vice chair and Great Neck Library president. Record claims about lowering costs and "record fines" on PSEG overstate what the public record shows for his part.

1. Offices and appointments are confirmed by state and press sources.
2. PSEG Long Island forfeited $30 million after Tropical Storm Isaias, but through a LIPA settlement; the site gives no figure and does not say what was his role.
